gates.reason: Filesystem destinations are derived through dedicated artifact-path logic, cache/artifact directory overlap is rejected after canonicalization, and git subprocesses use argument arrays rather than shell interpolation; no network or LLM egress exists.

Generation records repository identity and staleness inputs, incorporates parser-cohort state into cache validation, rerenders after size trimming, and commits the disposable parse cache only after the canonical artifact write succeeds.
The producer exposes file, directory-entry, token, persisted-byte, and parse-cache budgets, reuses per-file parses, and skips unchanged artifact writes.
Discovered roots are passed to Node as execFileSync arguments, not shell text; only existing directories are processed, and the driver performs no network or LLM egress.

Root discovery is deduplicated and deterministically sorted, missing roots are excluded, outcomes are tallied by the generator's explicit result values, and failures are reported without misclassifying them as successful writes.
Discovery uses capped helpers, root count defaults to a hard limit of 50, and every producer invocation has a per-root timeout.
Child processes use fixed executables with argument arrays, HOME is sandboxed to fresh temporary directories, and recursive cleanup targets only paths returned by mkdtempSync.

Tests round-trip artifacts through the real consumer, verify cache invalidation and write ordering, exercise discovery caps and stale-root rediscovery, and assert parser-boundary behavior reproducibly.
This is test-only code and is not part of a request, ingest, assemble, render, or production refresh hot path.
